input.query: WITH m AS (SELECT a.month,sum(card_spend_eur)/count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN is_active THEN a.user_id END) spa FROM fct_activity_monthly a JOIN dim_users u USING(user_id) WHERE country='RO' GROUP BY 1), changes AS(SELECT month,spa/lag(spa,2) OVER(ORDER BY month)-1 change FROM m) SELECT 'historical two-month changes, Jan 2025-Feb 2026' metric,avg(change) mean_change,stddev_samp(change) sd_change,min(change) min_change,max(change) max_change FROM changes WHERE month BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2026-02-01' UNION ALL SELECT 'March-May 2026',change,NULL,NULL,NULL FROM changes WHERE month='2026-05-01' UNION ALL SELECT 'March-May 2025',change,NULL,NULL,NULL FROM changes WHERE month='2025-05-01';
